# TheFreeDirectory.com

> > A comprehensive free online dictionary and reference portal providing word definitions, etymologies, and linguistic information from sources including Dictionary.com, Cambridge Dictionary, and Wiktionary.

This site aggregates dictionary entries and reference content from multiple authoritative sources to provide comprehensive word definitions, usage examples, grammatical information, and etymological history. It also includes general reference content from Wikipedia and other encyclopedic sources.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions
- Word etymology
- Prepositions and adverbs
- English language grammar
- Word meanings and usage
- Linguistic history
- Dictionary.com
- Cambridge Dictionary
- Wiktionary
- Collins English Dictionary
- HarperCollins Publishers
- Alternative word forms
- Grammatical classifications

## Dictionary & Word Definitions

- [ABOUT Definition & Meaning | Dictionary.com](https://dictionary.com/browse/about): Dictionary.com definition entry for 'about' with usage examples
- [ABOUT | English meaning - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/about): Cambridge Dictionary entry defining 'about' as preposition/adverb
- [about - Wiktionary, the free dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/about): Wiktionary entry for 'about' with etymology and linguistic history

## Optional
